releases.name: landstrip 0.22.3
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.22.3

landstrip:
- ci: Exercise both Linux sandbox backends in CI and release flows (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- doctor: Report resolved Linux backend in DoctorReport (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- container: Format /proc paths and readlink buffers on the stack (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- container: Materialize ancestor directories lazily in path walks (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- container: Read tracee C strings page by page (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: Support Linux backend config and container traps (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- selftest: Support Linux --backend selection (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Add container backend and --backend option (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- trap: Parameterize Linux denial trap mechanism (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Short-circuit /proc/self checks and fold special-path walks (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Read fixed-size guest buffers and C strings without heap allocation (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Synchronize vCPU registers via kvm_run and delta writes (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Pin cwd and target sockets across Unix endpoint mediation (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Pin working directories and descriptors across fs and exec (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

opencode-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.22.3 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- opencode: Wrap test fixture line to satisfy oxfmt (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- opencode: Support Linux sandbox backend configuration (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

pi-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.22.3 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- pi-landstrip: Support Linux sandbox backend configuration (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

Signed-off-by: Jarkko Sakkinen <jarkko.sakkinen@iki.fi>

releases.name: landstrip 0.22.1
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.22.1

landstrip:
- policy: Carve allowRead paths out of concrete denyRead roots (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- macos: Express root deny carve-outs as require-not filters (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Authorize the canonical executable path (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Terminate shebang lines at NUL (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Name ELF image mappings in /proc/self/maps (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Load ELF segments like the kernel (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Validate ELF layout, entry, and stack bounds (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Emulate RLIMIT_AS for the guest (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Factor out install_anon_mmap (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Mask unknown protection bits in mmap (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Identify SysV shm attachments by unique ID (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Reset host memory when growing brk (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Unmap the portion of a munmap range above RESERVED_END (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Reject MAP_GROWSDOWN and MAP_HUGETLB in mmap (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Recover address-space state after a failed mremap (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Strip SHM_EXEC from host shmat flags (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Update guest page tables with atomic stores (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Grow the x86-64 TSS pool to 1024 slots (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Mask x86-64 RFLAGS on SYSCALL entry (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Hide x86-64 CPUID leaf 7 subleaves above 0 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Enable CR4.FSGSBASE on x86-64 when the host supports it (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Block signals on exiting guest threads (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Queue kill()-sent signals process-wide (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Discard pending signals when they become ignored (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Install host handlers for synchronous fault signals (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Default SIGPIPE for guests and mirror ignored signals on host (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Reset FPU and vector state on signal delivery and exec (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Preserve guest TLS state across rt_sigreturn (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Deliver SIGSEGV on invalid sigreturn and user return state (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Unwind interrupted x86-64 ring-0 exception handler frames (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Re-issue x86-64 syscalls interrupted at stub entry (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Refine SA_RESTART syscall restartability (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Pin path xattr targets across the policy check (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Preserve ENOTDIR when pinned metadata mutations carry a trailing slash (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Mediate inotify_add_watch as a read (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Truncate faccessat mode/flags to int like the kernel (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Apply link and read rules to every rename/link path (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Re-check opened descriptors against the policy (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Deny dangerous /proc entries and broker-internal paths (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Report errors when synthesizing /proc/self/maps (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Rework /proc/self/exe and maps emulation (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Hide broker fds from /proc/self/fd directory listings (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Hide broker fds from all path-based syscalls (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Resolve paths beneath /proc/self/fd/N and /dev/fd/N (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Report both read and write denials of an open (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Resolve AT_EMPTY_PATH and NULL-path mutation descriptor targets (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Label deleted memfds as anonymous (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Fail closed when probing a path fails (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Refuse F_SETOWN and F_SETOWN_EX targeting pid 1 or pgrp 1 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Fix ppoll timeout handling when invalid fds force immediate return (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Return EFAULT when copying socket or poll results back fails (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Relocate SCM_RIGHTS fds received above the reserve floor (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- kvm: Parse control messages with the kernel cmsghdr layout (Jarkko Sakkinen)
